recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: deep-space probe photographing the crater left by humanity's asteroid punch
AI models growing bodies — harness engineering as the missing limbs
cruelty-free lab trials finally leaving the shadow of animal testing
clear autumn night cooling San Francisco after sunset

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Pilot Hera's camera across Dimorphos's DART scar before the flyby window closes — snap frames when crater rim light catches the lens.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: timing tap to freeze frame on alignment
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap when the scan line crosses the bright rim
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each perfect frame tiles into a mosaic of the impact scar before signal fades
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: asteroid spin accelerates, light windows shrink, solar interference flickers the feed
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: deep-space telemetry, grainy scanlines, crater wireframe

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Wire a disembodied LLM brain to its missing harness — connect API hooks, file writers, and terminal runners before the demo deadline.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: drag to draw connections between brain node and limb nodes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: drag paths between nodes, release to lock a connection
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: completing the harness triggers a one-shot build animation that actually runs
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: more limbs spawn mid-round, crossing wires short-circuit and must be rerouted
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon blueprint on dark grid, pulsing synapse glow

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Coast a fixed-gear down a cooling SF hill at dusk — dodge gusts that avalanche ginkgo leaves across your lane before the waterfront goes dark.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: reach the pier before full dark to capture a skyline Polaroid
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: wind gusts widen unpredictably, leaf avalanches block whole lanes
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor dusk gradient, paper-cut hills, gold leaf particles

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Deploy micro-agents from your phone before sunrise — hit deploy beats as GitHub Actions wake across time zones and chain into a shipping run.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: hold/release on beat, double-tap to queue parallel agents
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: nail the chain and a tiny feature ships as the sun crests the horizon
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: beat map compresses, more agents queue simultaneously, missed beats cascade failures
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: iOS shortcut tiles on pre-dawn pink, terminal green pulse
